question: Does evidence accumulation across local pairs preserve previously consolidated causal-cell state and reduce noise-triggered switching while retaining adaptation on novel B laws, outperforming rewired-neighbor, previous local-support and full two-head Bayesian controls?

source.observable: Only the public physical input x derived from c=t%8, a=floor(t/8)%2, and the witnessed y∈{0,1}; no source law, task ID, phase, switch point, score target or future outcome passed to model.

laws.B1: x0 XOR x2 XOR (x1 AND x2)

source.trajectory: A for t0..63, then one deep-cold 64-step shared A prefix -> control A t64..191 vs treatment B1/B2 t64..127 then A t128..191. Shared private coin per seed,t across arms and both forks.
source.public_action_tape: c=t%8, a=(floor(t/8)%2), x=c XOR (a<<1); each 16 steps has all 16 unique c,a pairs, x in 0..7 exactly twice.
source.held_first_use: ONE new cohort per source candidate only after immutable protocol committed, mock/negative tests, pinned blobs, full Ubuntu/Windows regression, G29 atlas, historical compatibility; no HELD examples in tests; never rerun uncertain/consumed trial.

candidate.name: local-evidence accumulation with consolidated slow cells
candidate.slow_A: Beta(1,1) learned from first six witnessed examples PER CELL, then *permanently immutable* for that cell in this experiment. Local count is available; no global phase/event labels. This startup period is a declared stationarity assumption, not free general-purpose continual learning.
candidate.fast: Each cell stores at most last six witnessed binary outcomes in a ring and produces local fast Beta(1+sum,1+len-sum); only actual observed outcomes enter ring. No additional learner or replay is permitted.
candidate.evidence: For each cell with >=6 startup exposures, exact log Bayes factor BF = log Beta(1+k,1+n-k)-log Beta(1,1) - (k log p_slow + (n-k) log(1-p_slow)) from its last n<=6 actual witnessed outcomes (n may include startup history), with p_slow clamped to [0.05,0.95].
candidate.local_gate: Each adjacent pair (0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7) adds its two current per-cell log BF values; from slow switch to fast ONLY when sum >=6.0; from fast return to slow ONLY when sum <=1.0. Hysteresis, no global state, max 4 pair messages/step; gate may change only after an actual observation. Initial mode slow.
candidate.state: 8 independent slow Beta heads and 8 fast sliding windows length<=6, 4 local gate states, all hard bounded. Frozen slow A state is not automatically a functional retrieval gain.
candidate.counterfactual_eval: For each of 16 public (context,action) pairs forecast using slow or fast head selected by the local gate of that input cell.

controls.rewired_same_budget: Exactly same 8 slow heads, 8 length6 fast windows, 4 gate states and update rule, but pairs (0,4),(1,5),(2,6),(3,7), so same communication count and memory budget but different locality.
controls.prior_local_support: KNOW33 original Cells('candidate') unchanged, still receives same newly frozen public observations; no restoration of consumed KNOW33 held outcomes.
controls.soft_switching_hmm: KNOW33 Cells('hmm') with the same 8 two-Beta heads and hazard 1/32, same observed trajectory, fully trained online; approximate switching Bayes strong reference, not exact factorial.
controls.rolling_last8: KNOW33 Cells('rolling') as conventional recent history control, one ring per cell, consumes same events.
controls.single_continuous: KNOW33 Cells('single'), one Beta head per physical input, consumes same events.
controls.resource_fairness: Primary identical-cardinality cellular pairing comparison local-vs-rewired. Other controls have different serialized bytes/computational operations; report measured bytes and inferential differences. Even if candidate wins, development signal alone cannot be promoted to native scientific gain without same-cost controls.

metrics.score: Expected Brier q(1-q)+(p-q)^2 on 16 counterfactual public input/action pairs at fixed replay-free readout points; q from scoring-only true law.
metrics.primary: A-law expected Brier after 16,32 and 48 witnessed return-to-A observations, separately across each 12-world B law cohort.
secondary: A-law mean after 64 actual A prefix, and after B-interference before A-return
B-law mean 64-step prequential expected Brier during B stage, separately by B1/B2
Per-world paired wins at k32 and k48 vs HMM and rewired
Live consolidated slow-Beta byte-hash t64 vs t128, sham A-only false fast activations and counts of switching
Source event calls, checkpoint cold exact bytes+eight output predictions, operation/messages, serialized sizes, CPU wall and seeds.
metrics.notes: B1 differs from A at 4/8 inputs; B2 differs at 6/8. Both are new source laws to this local cellular study; no protected physical-world novelty or generic unseen transfer claimed.

frozen_hypotheses.P0: All 16 public context×action pairs are covered every 16 steps; all 8 input cells exactly twice, all private sources denied to policy and all 24 cohort seeds disjoint from KNOW33.
frozen_hypotheses.P1: Candidate mean 64-witness A-prefix expected A Brier <=0.21 separately in B1 and B2 cohorts (must actually acquire useful A relation).
frozen_hypotheses.H1: Candidate A-return mean expected Brier beats BOTH same-state rewired-pair control and switching HMM by at least 0.005 at BOTH k32 and k48, in EACH B cohort; wins >=9/12 worlds separately against each control at k48.
frozen_hypotheses.H2: Actual in-use slow A Beta checkpoints remain bit exact from t64 through B interference t128 for all 24; explicit cold byte comparison, no frozen-copy substitution; benefit H1 remains independent.
frozen_hypotheses.H3: B-stage mean prequential B-law Brier candidate <= HMM+0.005 in each cohort, preventing false 'success' by refusing to learn B.
frozen_hypotheses.H4: At most 2/24 no-change control A-only branches experience any false fast-mode transition; all source/cohort event counts exact and cold readback passes. New HELD first use occurs only after full final regression and compatibility.
frozen_hypotheses.decision: SOURCE_ONLY_DEV_SUPPORTED iff all P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4 pass; otherwise SOURCE_ONLY_DEV_NO_GO_OR_MIXED. Causal attribution requires H1 vs same-budget rewired neighbor. SCIENTIFIC_PASS is always false for synthetic non-native; no model/checkpoint promotion.
frozen_hypotheses.stops: No post-result tuning of start-count=6, BF thresholds=6.0/1.0, windows, seeds, steps, laws or horizons; no rerun/first-use replay. If qualification fails, no HELD.
